context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login via Playwright kept redirecting back to /admin/login (session cookie not persisted across the POST->302->/admin->302 chain inside Playwright context in this environment). The underlying functionality is fine - verified instead via curl session (POST /admin/login with CSRF, then GET /admin/report, /admin/report?type=hotel|activity|boat). If testing admin via Playwright again, consider using a persistent browser context, or use requests/curl for admin HTML assertions. The animated 'pg-intro' splash can be dismissed with sessionStorage.setItem('pg-intro-seen','1'); document.getElementById('pg-intro')?.remove(); document.documentElement.classList.remove('pg-intro-lock');
